episodes.title: THE FIRST GIANT RETREATED
episodes.subtitle: IT WAS RETREATING.

still.caption:
The first giant wasn't reaching for Earth. It was pulling away.

Its enormous hand hovered over the planet, but its attention was fixed on the dark ring behind it. For the first time, something larger than our world looked afraid.

Follow Colossus Signal for the next sign of what it saw.

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #GiantAlien

episodes.title: THREE STARS DIDN'T RETURN
episodes.subtitle: SOMETHING ERASED THEM.

still.caption:
Three stars were missing. Then the red glow appeared.

Beyond the Moon, a colossal face emerged among the drifting debris. Those burning red marks are not distant suns. They belong to something watching the space where the lights disappeared.

Look closely at the darkness around its face.

#ColossusSignal #SpaceHorror #CosmicMystery
still.first_comment: SIGNAL NOTE: The red lights sit within one enormous shape. The missing stars are the mystery; the face is the first clue that the darkness may be alive.

episodes.title: IT HID ITS OWN LIGHT
episodes.subtitle: EVEN GIANTS CAN BE AFRAID.

still.caption:
A giant was trying to hide its own light.

A blue fissure burned through a colossal black shell above Earth. Its armored surface curved inward around the glow, as if even that small signal had become dangerous to reveal.

Stay with the signal. The next anomaly reaches the ocean.

#ColossusSignal #SciFiHorror #AlienTitan

episodes.title: THE OCEAN PULLED AWAY
episodes.subtitle: THE SEA KNEW FIRST.

still.caption:
The ocean moved before the hand ever touched it.

A colossal hand hung over Earth's waters. Far below, the sea folded toward a circular abyss, while the giant remained suspended above the clouds. The distance between them was the frightening part.

Would you have watched the water—or the hand?

#ColossusSignal #PlanetaryHorror #CosmicHorror

episodes.title: THE DEBRIS FELL UPWARD
episodes.subtitle: GRAVITY NO LONGER WORKS.

still.caption:
The debris was falling in the wrong direction.

Thousands of rocks drifted away from Earth's night side and toward a vast black opening. Whatever waited beyond that ring seemed to pull the fragments through space instead of letting them fall.

Trace the path of the smallest pieces.

#ColossusSignal #SpaceHorror #GravityAnomaly
still.first_comment: FIELD NOTE: The rocks form a stream toward the bright rim of the darkness. The effect reads less like an explosion and more like an enormous pull.

Earth's lights didn't disappear all at once.

A vast shadow spread across the planet's night side. Some cities still glowed beneath the clouds; others faded into an unnatural darkness. Above Earth, the source of that shadow was almost impossible to separate from space.

Find where the darkness begins.

#ColossusSignal #DarkSciFi #PlanetaryHorror

episodes.subtitle: IT WENT INTO THE DARKNESS.

still.caption:
One giant crossed the red boundary. Another stayed behind.

A distant titan drifted into the blazing dark opening while a second colossal figure reached from above Earth. The space between them was closing, but the opening offered no glimpse of what lay beyond.

Would you have followed it into the red void?

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #AlienTitan

still.caption:
Three titans stopped facing the same darkness.

Above Earth, three distinct colossal figures held their ground beneath an impossible vertical mass. None faced the planet. Their attention was fixed upward, as though they had all recognized the same danger.

Which detail tells you they are afraid?

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #AlienGiants

episodes.title: THE SHAPE BEHIND THE DARK
episodes.subtitle: IT HAD A BODY.

still.caption:
What if the darkness wasn't a doorway?

A colossal ring loomed over Earth while tiny giants gathered near its edge. The curved black layers around the opening looked less like machinery and more like parts of a hidden body. We may have been looking at it all along.

Look again at the structure surrounding the void.

#ColossusSignal #CosmicMystery #SciFiHorror

episodes.title: THEY STOOD BETWEEN US
episodes.subtitle: THREE GIANTS. ONE LAST SHIELD.

still.caption:
The giants weren't surrounding Earth. They were shielding it.

Three colossal figures stood between the planet and a lightless opening in the sky. The beings that once terrified us now faced outward—toward something too vast to confront alone.

Follow the signal into the Halloween finale.

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #HalloweenSciFi

still.caption:
At last, we know what the giants were afraid of.

Three colossal guardians stood between Earth and a darkness so vast it made them look small. It wasn't a distant star. It wasn't an empty doorway. Something in that darkness turned toward our tiny blue world.

The final transmission: IT FOUND US.

Would their last shield have been enough?

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #HalloweenHorror
still.first_comment: FINAL OBSERVATION: Follow the scale from Earth to the three guardians, then to the shape beyond them. Each comparison makes the previous giant look smaller. Their bodies face away from Earth. Maybe the last defense wasn't about winning a battle. Maybe it was about keeping one blue light hidden.
